name: Pest Control
metaDescription: The 2026 Pest Control Industry Report from Sherlock Research: market size, growth forecasts, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for U.S. pest control operators.
ogDescription: Market size, growth, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for the U.S. pest control services industry. 40+ pages, instant PDF.
heroDescription: Comprehensive data and local insights to help pest control operators grow recurring revenue, navigate chemical regulation, and price residential vs commercial confidently.
summary: Pest and termite control market research. Residential vs. commercial segments, seasonal patterns, and competitive benchmarks for your market.
lead: Pest control is one of the highest-quality recurring-revenue categories in home services: 78% of revenue comes from subscription plans. Demand is climate-correlated, regulation is tightening, and consolidation is reshaping the competitive landscape.

reviews.title: Grew recurring revenue 22% in one quarter
reviews.text: We'd been letting one-off treatments dominate our book. The report showed exactly how to convert one-time customers into quarterly plans — including the price points local buyers actually accept. Rolled out the script, recurring revenue jumped immediately.
reviews.cite: Tom L., Owner, residential pest control

reviews.title: Said no to a bad PE offer
reviews.text: A regional roll-up made us an offer. The valuation benchmarks in the report told us we were being lowballed by 25%. We countered, they walked, and 8 months later we got a 40% better offer from a different buyer.
reviews.cite: Patricia V., Founder, multi-location pest control

reviews.title: Launched mosquito service confidently
reviews.text: We were the third operator in our metro to add mosquito service. The local demand data showed there was still meaningful room. Launched the line, hit 200 subscribers in 90 days, and it's now our highest-margin add-on.
reviews.cite: Greg H., Owner, lawn & pest service
